steps.text: Talk to Marlo in north-east Varrock.
choices: What kind of favour do you want me to do?
Tell me more about the job.
Tell me where he lives, and I'll do the job.

steps.text: Talk to Old Man Yarlo in south-east Varrock, west of Aubury's Rune Shop.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo again after removing all the broken furniture.
choices: Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.

steps.text: Remove the broken furniture in Old Man Yarlo's house.
Rebuild the furniture in Old Man Yarlo's house.
Search the crates in Old Man Yarlo's house for waxwood logs.
Talk to the Sawmill operator north-east of Varrock to make waxwood planks.
choices: I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.

steps.text: Build the waxwood bed in Old Man Yarlo's house.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo again after rebuilding the furniture.
Talk to Marlo in north-east Varrock to complete the quest.
choices: Yeah, what have you got for me?
